message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a frozen shrimp scampi meal. Shrimp prepared or preserved falls under heading 1605.21 (shrimps and prawns, not in airtight containers) or 1605.29 (other, which covers airtight containers). A frozen product would go in 1605.21.

The subheading 1605.21 covers shrimp and prawns "not in airtight containers." The statistical suffixes under 1605.21 are:
- 1605.21.10 – Containing fish meal... Actually, 1605.21.05 covers "Products containing rice, or dough" and 1605.21.10 covers "Other, in immediate containers of a net contents not exceeding 2 kg" (or similar).

My recollection of the 1605.21 structure is:
- 1605.21.05: Shrimp and prawns, not in airtight containers: Containing fish meal... (uncertain)
- 1605.21.10: Other, in immediate containers weighing with their contents not over 2 kg
- 1605.21.20: Other

The actual HTSUS reads:
- 1605.21.10: "Shrimps and prawns, not in airtight containers: Frozen, in immediate containers weighing with their contents not more than 2 kg" (uncertain)
- 1605.21.1010 and 1605.21.1020: breaded, other

Since the sauce makes this a prepared product with 45% shrimp, I am settling on 1605.21.2090. The 1605.21.20 line, "Other," has a statistical suffix 90 for "Other," which is my best fit. I did not verify this against the current schedule.
